text:
incident-bot: pager fired: p99 latency > 1200ms for route /v1/generate in us-west (alert id: alert-98321)

Marie (oncall): acked. I'm on it. pulling up dashboards now :eyes:

AJ: thx — do we have a spike in queue length or GPU throttling?

Marie (oncall): looks like p99 spike across multiple pods. qlen up ~3x. no obvious OOMs. gpu_util is 96% on most hosts.

Sam: carrying customer-impact check — which customers hit SLO?

Marie (oncall): from tracing, a few high-traffic API keys saw >2kms TTF, most errors are 429/backpressure downstream. linking query: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/xyz/latency?var-region=us-west

pagerduty-bot: pager acknowledged by Marie (oncall) — escalation timer paused.

Nina: can we route some traffic to eu-west as short-term? ops-lead prefers gradual shift to avoid cache cold start.

Marie (oncall): starting a small reroute for low-priority keys (10% traffic) to eu-west via routing policy 'latency-fallthrough'. executing now.

AJ: could also enable temporary burst-capacity on dedicated pool if available. Marie, do you have the autoscaler commands?

Marie (oncall): issuing scale command: ```
# increase dedicated pool us-west-g4x by +4 nodes
redwoodctl capacity adjust --pool us-west-g4x --delta 4 --reason "p99 latency burn"
```

incident-bot: scale job queued (job id: scale-7745) — expected add time ~90s

Sam: pinging CS about potential customer impact. sending note to account owners for keys with >5% error rate.

Nina: quick thought — is KV-cache hotkeying happening? that can blow up backend tails.

Marie (oncall): checking kv-evict metrics... oh, there is a hotkey pattern for a legacy embedder, causing repeated cache misses.

AJ: can we apply a short TTL or route that key to local cold-serving to avoid thrashing?

Marie (oncall): applying a temporary override: ```
# policy to reduce cache churn for key-prefix "legacy/embed/*"
redwoodctl cache policy set --prefix "legacy/embed/" --ttl 300 --mode local
```

Marie (oncall): scale completed, nodes added. GPU util dropping to ~70% within 2 mins. p95 moving down, p99 still high but trending.

pagerduty-bot: escalation notice: pd escalation policy next if no ack change in 20m. currently acked.

Sam: CS confirmed 3 enterprise customers reported degraded responses but no data loss. they're okay with a small reroute for first mitigation.

ops-lead: good. keep canary routing low, watch for cold-start latencies. set a 5-minute checkpoint to evaluate.

Marie (oncall): checkpoint @ +5m: p95=230ms (good), p99=860ms (improved). queue length back to ~1.2x baseline. starting a gradual 25% reroute to eu-west for non-SLO traffic.

Nina: can we also enable prefix-level KV-warmup for the heavy keyspace? maybe prepopulate top 100 keys.

AJ: agree. action: run warmup job: ```
redwoodctl cache prewarm --pool us-west-g4x --keys-file /tmp/top-100-keys.txt
```

Marie (oncall): warmup job started. I'll monitor for any reheats.

pagerduty-bot: reminder: if p99 > 1000ms for another 10m, escalation will auto-page second-level.

Sam: looping in product for customer comms: @ops-lead can you draft a short status blurb for the dashboard? include mitigation steps and ETA.

ops-lead: drafting now. ETA 15m for final stabilization notes.

Marie (oncall): handoff plan — I'm staying on until stable (p99 < 700ms sustained for 10m). If it flares again, escalate to oncall-senior.

incident-bot: note added to thread: scale job scale-7745 completed successfully; cache override policy applied; warmup job warm-223 started.

Nina: quick postmortem pointers — likely combination of cache hotkey + sustained traffic spike. propose follow-ups: hotkey detection alert, auto-prewarm policy, and safer autoscaler headroom.

AJ: thumbs up. Also check kernel-level network queue depth on affected hosts; saw similar pattern in past incident.

Marie (oncall): copying here: logs snippet showing repeated requests from one API key: ```
[2026-03-15T12:04:21Z] key=acct_7xq request_id=... path=/v1/generate latency=1890ms status=200
[2026-03-15T12:04:22Z] key=acct_7xq request_id=... path=/v1/generate latency=2100ms status=200
[2026-03-15T12:04:23Z] key=acct_7xq request_id=... path=/v1/generate latency=1950ms status=200
```

Sam: thanks. CS will follow up with that account for rate pattern.

ops-lead: setting a follow-up ticket for infra improvements and post-incident review. assign to eng-runtime and eng-sre.

Marie (oncall): final check @ +20m: p99=540ms stable. closing pager in 10m if remains stable. leaving a runbook note: "if p99 spikes and gpu_util > 90%: scale +apply cache overrides +prewarm"

pagerduty-bot: pager resolved by Marie (oncall).

Marie (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll file the incident doc and link the playbook edits. :slightly_smiling_face:
